methods.hardware: Trial process: platform.processor, os.cpu_count and platform.platform; exact CPU model, physical cores and RAM recorded separately in README using Get-CimInstance
methods.times: Python perf_counter; total_load includes Python package imports, frontend init and model init, excludes process startup and asset checksum preflight; first PCM is from input frontend start; generation and synchronous playback timed separately
methods.memory: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo PeakWorkingSetSize for the full process
methods.raw: Sum ZIP/wheel uncompressed member sizes plus original ONNX/config/model card and the unopened VC installer; preserves upstream duplicate members
methods.download: Sum distinct pinned artifact file bytes; no estimate of HTTP/TLS traffic
methods.installed: Sum actual package file logical sizes, including evidence, inventory and the retained VC prerequisite installer; excludes filesystem allocation slack
methods.compressed: Actual whole-package ZIP_DEFLATED level 9, CRC, exact member set and SHA-256 against every inventory entry

quality.feedback: Pass: école ends in /l/ and the samples are correct

limitations: OS caches were not cleared; these are fresh processes, not certified cold starts
The listening verdict applies to the saved replacement samples; package-run audio was not separately reviewed
VC installer was retained without execution; clean-machine dependencies are untested
Sandbox harness and existing host tools are recorded separately, not shipped as speech resources
Other-platform execution and full binary redistribution verification remain untested
